'''Jerry Jones''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2000 Tempe tournament]] on 30 July 2000 with [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|MWYHL test deck]], according to Brian Garrison's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1060">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-30-arizona-gamer-randomness-not-allowedd1060/ arizona-gamer-randomness-not-allowed], DeckTech (Brian "bgkenobi" Garrison, 30 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-30-arizona-gamer-randomness-not-allowedd1060/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
